review_evidence: README describes Nerodia as a work-in-progress Lean/Python FFI library inspired by PyO3.
Across 79 Lean files, the proposition scan found only one small type-tag theorem (PyEnvironment.noneRaw_hasType); the overwhelming source surface is Python object/FFI/build integration.
There is no independently addressable mathematical development or proved semantics for the FFI layer.
